The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pembric II]] was controlled by a '''corporate government''' following the establishment of the colony on the surface. It turned a blind [[Eye/Legends|eye]] to the organized crime on the planet as long as they kept feeding [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] into the economy.
